brief.headline: Fix the 40% return rate first, then benchmark price to the ₹0.65–0.80/pc market band at volume

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc for the 28 mm PP cap at higher volumes
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for this cap sits at ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. At volume or with looser specs, the fair band drops to ₹0.65–0.80/pc — ask for that lower band as our baseline.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 days until quality stabilizes; if returns drop below 10%, offer 15 days in exchange for a 1–2% price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier would free up ₹6817 cash for us — worth it only if they cut price and fix the return problem

brief.financialLeverage: Scorpion publishes no financials, so we can't see their cash position or profit. Our ₹1.66 L annual spend is tiny for any packaging converter, so we have zero volume leverage. That means our main card is supply security: we have five strong alternates already qualified (including Manjushree, India's largest rigid-plastic converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue), so walking away costs us nothing. Use that to anchor price at the market fair band and to demand they solve the 40% return rate before we grow the business.

evidence.point: Four out of every ten items they deliver get sent back
Our annual spend with them is tiny
Market asking price for a 28 mm PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
At higher volume or looser spec, fair market price drops to ₹0.65–0.80/pc
HDPE resin import cost is 87.61 ₹/kg — a sanity check for raw-material trends

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate already on our list

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma) — strong, profitable, robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging specialist — broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: The 40% return rate screams quality or spec mismatch — if we push hard on price before that's fixed, we risk even worse delivery performance
Our ₹1.66 L spend gives us no volume leverage; they may not care if we walk — so lead with supply security (naming alternates) rather than spend share
Scorpion's financials aren't public, so we can't tell if they're struggling or stable — watch for signs of cash trouble (late shipments, requests for advance payment) during the meeting
The market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads to qualify (verify capability and get quotes before treating any as a live second source)
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We need to talk about the 40% return rate and then align your pricing to the ₹0.65–0.80 market band — we've lined up three qualified alternates, so let's fix quality and price together or we'll move the business.
